meta.title: Garden Explorers
meta.description: The New Year begins, and a quiet chorus begins in the garden.

units.rawText: Before the New Year, the Oasis.
units.displayText: Before the New Year, the Oasis.

spans.text: Before the New Year, the Oasis.

units.rawText: The Oasis was filled with the mirth that comes with another New Year, and the agents were busy discussing the various arrangements to be made, especially that rumor of vague origin.
units.displayText: The Oasis was filled with the mirth that comes with another New Year, and the agents were busy discussing the various arrangements to be made, especially that rumor of vague origin.

spans.text: The Oasis was filled with the mirth that comes with another New Year, and the agents were busy discussing the various arrangements to be made, especially that rumor of vague origin.

units.rawText: A mysterious event at the festival... sounds intriguing. Banxsy, what do you think they'll cook up?
units.displayText: A mysterious event at the festival... sounds intriguing. Banxsy, what do you think they'll cook up?

spans.text: A mysterious event at the festival... sounds intriguing. Banxsy, what do you think they'll cook up?

units.rawText: It's probably just to hype things up for New Year's. I do concede that they're damn good at keeping a lid on things; even as stall hosts at the event, we don't know anything about it.
units.displayText: It's probably just to hype things up for New Year's. I do concede that they're damn good at keeping a lid on things; even as stall hosts at the event, we don't know anything about it.

spans.text: It's probably just to hype things up for New Year's. I do concede that they're damn good at keeping a lid on things; even as stall hosts at the event, we don't know anything about it.

units.rawText: Though... can you really afford to divert your attention to other events? Is your prep for the music on the day complete?
units.displayText: Though... can you really afford to divert your attention to other events? Is your prep for the music on the day complete?

spans.text: Though... can you really afford to divert your attention to other events? Is your prep for the music on the day complete?

units.rawText: Uhh—my good pal inspiration says she's on the way, for real.
units.displayText: Uhh—my good pal inspiration says she's on the way, for real.

spans.text: Uhh—my good pal inspiration says she's on the way, for real.

units.rawText: She awkwardly averts her gaze as Banxsy's emotionless eyes burn into her, turning around to see Sakuya and Croque approach.
units.displayText: She awkwardly averts her gaze as Banxsy's emotionless eyes burn into her, turning around to see Sakuya and Croque approach.

spans.text: She awkwardly averts her gaze as Banxsy's emotionless eyes burn into her, turning around to see Sakuya and Croque approach.

units.rawText: Heyyy! Croque, Sakuya, perfect timing!
units.displayText: Heyyy! Croque, Sakuya, perfect timing!

spans.text: Heyyy! Croque, Sakuya, perfect timing!

units.rawText: You're all organizers for the festival, so you should know all about the events going on there, right?
units.displayText: You're all organizers for the festival, so you should know all about the events going on there, right?

spans.text: You're all organizers for the festival, so you should know all about the events going on there, right?

units.rawText: Yeah... that's right and all, but...
units.displayText: Yeah... that's right and all, but...

spans.text: Yeah... that's right and all, but...

units.rawText: Croque, you look a bit on edge; has something happened?
units.displayText: Croque, you look a bit on edge; has something happened?

spans.text: Croque, you look a bit on edge; has something happened?

units.rawText: (I just wanted to go sort out some issues at the venue. Why am I running into this type of thing? This socialization without a sense of distance is terrifying. The light of humanity is truly blinding—)
units.displayText: I just wanted to go sort out some issues at the venue. Why am I running into this type of thing? This socialization without a sense of distance is terrifying. The light of humanity is truly blinding—

spans.text: I just wanted to go sort out some issues at the venue. Why am I running into this type of thing? This socialization without a sense of distance is terrifying. The light of humanity is truly blinding—

units.rawText: N-No... Hahaha...
units.displayText: N-No... Hahaha...

spans.text: N-No... Hahaha...

units.rawText: Calm and collected, Sakuya takes half a step forward, shielding Croque's wincing countenance behind her. As the latter casts a thankful look her way, she picks up the conversation.
units.displayText: Calm and collected, Sakuya takes half a step forward, shielding Croque's wincing countenance behind her. As the latter casts a thankful look her way, she picks up the conversation.

spans.text: Calm and collected, Sakuya takes half a step forward, shielding Croque's wincing countenance behind her. As the latter casts a thankful look her way, she picks up the conversation.

units.rawText: Thank you for your concern, but the work relevant to the preparation of the festival is moving forward smoothly. I recall that your request for a stall position at the festival went through. Did you encounter any other problems that you might need our help with?
units.displayText: Thank you for your concern, but the work relevant to the preparation of the festival is moving forward smoothly. I recall that your request for a stall position at the festival went through. Did you encounter any other problems that you might need our help with?

spans.text: Thank you for your concern, but the work relevant to the preparation of the festival is moving forward smoothly. I recall that your request for a stall position at the festival went through. Did you encounter any other problems that you might need our help with?

units.rawText: (Sakuya... listen to me, man, I gotta say thank you—)
units.displayText: Sakuya... listen to me, man, I gotta say thank you—

spans.text: Sakuya... listen to me, man, I gotta say thank you—

units.rawText: Oh, not in particular. I just wanted to ask about all the stuff going around about this mysterious event recently. Is there anything you could leak to us about it?
units.displayText: Oh, not in particular. I just wanted to ask about all the stuff going around about this mysterious event recently. Is there anything you could leak to us about it?

spans.text: Oh, not in particular. I just wanted to ask about all the stuff going around about this mysterious event recently. Is there anything you could leak to us about it?

units.rawText: Perhaps it'd be something of a source of inspiration for a new piece!
units.displayText: Perhaps it'd be something of a source of inspiration for a new piece!

spans.text: Perhaps it'd be something of a source of inspiration for a new piece!

units.rawText: Ahaha... how should I put it...
units.displayText: Ahaha... how should I put it...

spans.text: Ahaha... how should I put it...

units.rawText: Truth is, we aren't sure either. This close to New Year's, the affairs around the venue are enough to keep us more than busy.
units.displayText: Truth is, we aren't sure either. This close to New Year's, the affairs around the venue are enough to keep us more than busy.

spans.text: Truth is, we aren't sure either. This close to New Year's, the affairs around the venue are enough to keep us more than busy.

units.rawText: Yeah, yeah! We're on our way to deal with something on the grounds.
units.displayText: Yeah, yeah! We're on our way to deal with something on the grounds.

spans.text: Yeah, yeah! We're on our way to deal with something on the grounds.

units.rawText: Hmm... alright. The venue still isn't open, so your schedules are bound to be full, yeah? Must be difficult.
units.displayText: Hmm... alright. The venue still isn't open, so your schedules are bound to be full, yeah? Must be difficult.

spans.text: Hmm... alright. The venue still isn't open, so your schedules are bound to be full, yeah? Must be difficult.

units.rawText: I'd rather have you spend this time preparing your stall properly, Groove. Remember to give me a demo of what you're working on.
units.displayText: I'd rather have you spend this time preparing your stall properly, Groove. Remember to give me a demo of what you're working on.

spans.text: I'd rather have you spend this time preparing your stall properly, Groove. Remember to give me a demo of what you're working on.

units.rawText: I need it for background noise when I draft up my work later tonight.
units.displayText: I need it for background noise when I draft up my work later tonight.

spans.text: I need it for background noise when I draft up my work later tonight.

units.rawText: Okay, okay, right away...
units.displayText: Okay, okay, right away...

spans.text: Okay, okay, right away...

units.rawText: Watching as the pair departs, Croque exhales in relief.
units.displayText: Watching as the pair departs, Croque exhales in relief.

spans.text: Watching as the pair departs, Croque exhales in relief.

units.rawText: Thanks, Sakuya, I'm really not good at lying in those situations. I thought we were done for...
units.displayText: Thanks, Sakuya, I'm really not good at lying in those situations. I thought we were done for...

spans.text: Thanks, Sakuya, I'm really not good at lying in those situations. I thought we were done for...

units.rawText: My hands are covered in sweat, and I thought I was going to drop my wrench. Screw whoever leaked it.
units.displayText: My hands are covered in sweat, and I thought I was going to drop my wrench. Screw whoever leaked it.

spans.text: My hands are covered in sweat, and I thought I was going to drop my wrench. Screw whoever leaked it.

units.rawText: It wouldn't be a big deal if it really were only rumors. With such a large venue, it is only natural for people to be curious about what's inside.
units.displayText: It wouldn't be a big deal if it really were only rumors. With such a large venue, it is only natural for people to be curious about what's inside.

spans.text: It wouldn't be a big deal if it really were only rumors. With such a large venue, it is only natural for people to be curious about what's inside.

units.rawText: The posts about the secret event on the forums would be enough to fill up another board, but that's not the point. The most problematic thing is that there are people in these posts stirring the pot under the name of official organizers.
units.displayText: The posts about the secret event on the forums would be enough to fill up another board, but that's not the point. The most problematic thing is that there are people in these posts stirring the pot under the name of official organizers.

spans.text: The posts about the secret event on the forums would be enough to fill up another board, but that's not the point. The most problematic thing is that there are people in these posts stirring the pot under the name of official organizers.

units.rawText: So the one you were talking about... what was it...
units.displayText: So the one you were talking about... what was it...

spans.text: So the one you were talking about... what was it...

units.rawText: Croque furrows her brow, pulling forth a screen.
units.displayText: Croque furrows her brow, pulling forth a screen.

spans.text: Croque furrows her brow, pulling forth a screen.

units.rawText: [Festival's Big Reveal - Participate, and get a chance to fulfill a wish].
units.displayText: [Festival's Big Reveal - Participate, and get a chance to fulfill a wish].

spans.text: [Festival's Big Reveal - Participate, and get a chance to fulfill a wish].

units.rawText: Yeah, that post. The contents are very explicit, and there seems to be no shortage of agents who believe it, judging by the amount of replies.
units.displayText: Yeah, that post. The contents are very explicit, and there seems to be no shortage of agents who believe it, judging by the amount of replies.

spans.text: Yeah, that post. The contents are very explicit, and there seems to be no shortage of agents who believe it, judging by the amount of replies.

units.rawText: I'm currently investigating this matter. Do you have any suspects?
units.displayText: I'm currently investigating this matter. Do you have any suspects?

spans.text: I'm currently investigating this matter. Do you have any suspects?

units.rawText: You are asking me? Let me think...
units.displayText: You are asking me? Let me think...

spans.text: You are asking me? Let me think...

units.rawText: I feel like too many people in the Oasis would do this, so it's hard to pin down one suspect. Speaking of which, if we're looking for the source of a message, wouldn't it be easier to get Anna to look around internally?
units.displayText: I feel like too many people in the Oasis would do this, so it's hard to pin down one suspect. Speaking of which, if we're looking for the source of a message, wouldn't it be easier to get Anna to look around internally?

spans.text: I feel like too many people in the Oasis would do this, so it's hard to pin down one suspect. Speaking of which, if we're looking for the source of a message, wouldn't it be easier to get Anna to look around internally?

units.rawText: I spoke to her, but she told me she could only delete posts. The anonymous board is a free space, as recognized by all the agents here as well as the Professor. She cannot and does not want to use these methods to damage the atmosphere there.
units.displayText: I spoke to her, but she told me she could only delete posts. The anonymous board is a free space, as recognized by all the agents here as well as the Professor. She cannot and does not want to use these methods to damage the atmosphere there.

spans.text: I spoke to her, but she told me she could only delete posts. The anonymous board is a free space, as recognized by all the agents here as well as the Professor. She cannot and does not want to use these methods to damage the atmosphere there.

units.rawText: That... alright. Although the timing is most unfortunate, we have enough problems on hand.
units.displayText: That... alright. Although the timing is most unfortunate, we have enough problems on hand.

spans.text: That... alright. Although the timing is most unfortunate, we have enough problems on hand.

units.rawText: There's nothing to be done about it. Organizing an event of this scale was never going to be easy.
units.displayText: There's nothing to be done about it. Organizing an event of this scale was never going to be easy.

spans.text: There's nothing to be done about it. Organizing an event of this scale was never going to be easy.

units.rawText: It's not unlike my gardening projects. No matter how pristine and perfect the plans and drafts are, a plethora of problems are bound to come up when putting it into practice.
units.displayText: It's not unlike my gardening projects. No matter how pristine and perfect the plans and drafts are, a plethora of problems are bound to come up when putting it into practice.

spans.text: It's not unlike my gardening projects. No matter how pristine and perfect the plans and drafts are, a plethora of problems are bound to come up when putting it into practice.

units.rawText: Oh, relax; I was just having a moment! I'll deal with everything that comes our way, for the joy of the New Year!
units.displayText: Oh, relax; I was just having a moment! I'll deal with everything that comes our way, for the joy of the New Year!

spans.text: Oh, relax; I was just having a moment! I'll deal with everything that comes our way, for the joy of the New Year!

units.rawText: Let's leave the task of taking down the posts to Anna. We have more important matters to attend to.
units.displayText: Let's leave the task of taking down the posts to Anna. We have more important matters to attend to.

spans.text: Let's leave the task of taking down the posts to Anna. We have more important matters to attend to.

units.rawText: You dare to reject ME, The Great Kuro's request for a stall? Hmph, what do you think you are, you pitiful little festival?

units.displayText: Jiangyu's reaction fails her as she tumbles down to the ground, holding her head as if she had been the victim of some great injustice.

spans.text: Jiangyu's reaction fails her as she tumbles down to the ground, holding her head as if she had been the victim of some great injustice.

units.rawText: Owie, that hurts... I lost...
units.displayText: Owie, that hurts... I lost...

spans.text: Owie, that hurts... I lost...

units.rawText: ...What's up with you? You've been consistently distracted, making low-level mistakes you'd never make before.
units.displayText: ...What's up with you? You've been consistently distracted, making low-level mistakes you'd never make before.

spans.text: ...What's up with you? You've been consistently distracted, making low-level mistakes you'd never make before.

units.rawText: Are you sleep-deprived? When I get less than 15 hours a day, I'm much the same way. I would recommend that you watch some streams of your favorite idols and replenish your mental fuel...
units.displayText: Are you sleep-deprived? When I get less than 15 hours a day, I'm much the same way. I would recommend that you watch some streams of your favorite idols and replenish your mental fuel...

spans.text: Are you sleep-deprived? When I get less than 15 hours a day, I'm much the same way. I would recommend that you watch some streams of your favorite idols and replenish your mental fuel...

units.rawText: Who the hell sleeps 15 hours a day? And I don't like idols either...
units.displayText: Who the hell sleeps 15 hours a day? And I don't like idols either...

spans.text: Who the hell sleeps 15 hours a day? And I don't like idols either...

units.rawText: Then you can have gyutandon...
units.displayText: Then you can have gyutandon...

spans.text: Then you can have gyutandon...

units.rawText: I don't want gyutandon either... hang on, that's not the point!
units.displayText: I don't want gyutandon either... hang on, that's not the point!

spans.text: I don't want gyutandon either... hang on, that's not the point!

units.rawText: Could it be some type of mental block? Or are you at the bottleneck of some technique?
units.displayText: Could it be some type of mental block? Or are you at the bottleneck of some technique?

spans.text: Could it be some type of mental block? Or are you at the bottleneck of some technique?

units.rawText: Sigh...
units.displayText: Sigh...

spans.text: Sigh...

units.rawText: Met with an unusually serious Aki, Jiangyu grew reluctant.
units.displayText: Met with an unusually serious Aki, Jiangyu grew reluctant.

spans.text: Met with an unusually serious Aki, Jiangyu grew reluctant.

units.rawText: If you have troubles, speak to me about them. Those who walk the martialist's path draw from what lies within. If the heart is clouded by doubt, it shows in one's movements.
units.displayText: If you have troubles, speak to me about them. Those who walk the martialist's path draw from what lies within. If the heart is clouded by doubt, it shows in one's movements.

spans.text: If you have troubles, speak to me about them. Those who walk the martialist's path draw from what lies within. If the heart is clouded by doubt, it shows in one's movements.

units.rawText: ...You're right. Well, I...
units.displayText: ...You're right. Well, I...

spans.text: ...You're right. Well, I...

units.rawText: Beep—
units.displayText: Beep—

spans.text: Beep—

units.rawText: Ah! I got a message back!
units.displayText: Ah! I got a message back!

spans.text: Ah! I got a message back!

units.rawText: The sudden notification interrupted their conversation. Without another word, Jiangyu dashed over to the training ground's edges, fishing out her terminal from a pile of clothing.
units.displayText: The sudden notification interrupted their conversation. Without another word, Jiangyu dashed over to the training ground's edges, fishing out her terminal from a pile of clothing.

spans.text: The sudden notification interrupted their conversation. Without another word, Jiangyu dashed over to the training ground's edges, fishing out her terminal from a pile of clothing.

units.rawText:
<color=orange>Sent Message</color> 
Is the part about fulfilling a wish for participating real?<|>
<color=orange>Onsite Message</color> 
Of course, but as you might have assumed, fulfilling a dream is no small task, and we cannot guarantee that every person who wishes to participate has a spot. First come, first served is all I can tell you about it right now. <|> 
<color=orange>Jiangyu is typing...</color> 
I see, thank you for the info! I'll do my best to attend! <|> 
<color=orange>Onsite Message</color> 
Best of luck in your endeavors!

units.rawText: Yay!

units.rawText: Yay...To what? Let me see... [Festival's Big Reveal - Participate and get a chance to fulfill a wish]... this is why you've been so absent-minded?
units.displayText: Yay...To what? Let me see... [Festival's Big Reveal - Participate and get a chance to fulfill a wish]... this is why you've been so absent-minded?

spans.text: Yay...To what? Let me see... [Festival's Big Reveal - Participate and get a chance to fulfill a wish]... this is why you've been so absent-minded?

units.rawText: Uwah, how'd you appear without a sound?
units.displayText: Uwah, how'd you appear without a sound?

spans.text: Uwah, how'd you appear without a sound?

units.rawText: I... followed you. To not even notice that, you must really be fixated on this...
units.displayText: I... followed you. To not even notice that, you must really be fixated on this...

spans.text: I... followed you. To not even notice that, you must really be fixated on this...

units.rawText: The venue isn't even open yet, is it? You're going to go there now?
units.displayText: The venue isn't even open yet, is it? You're going to go there now?

spans.text: The venue isn't even open yet, is it? You're going to go there now?

units.rawText: Yeah... there's a chance to fulfill a wish after all! How about it? Wanna go together?
units.displayText: Yeah... there's a chance to fulfill a wish after all! How about it? Wanna go together?

spans.text: Yeah... there's a chance to fulfill a wish after all! How about it? Wanna go together?

units.rawText: I'll pass, sounds like a pain. Those methods of getting what you want sound implausible. I'd rather just practice my art.
units.displayText: I'll pass, sounds like a pain. Those methods of getting what you want sound implausible. I'd rather just practice my art.

units.rawText: But my wish isn't to improve my martial arts skills...
units.displayText: But my wish isn't to improve my martial arts skills...

spans.text: But my wish isn't to improve my martial arts skills...

units.displayText: Jiangyu seems to think of something, and her expression becomes sullen.

spans.text: Jiangyu seems to think of something, and her expression becomes sullen.

units.rawText: You wouldn't get it anyway, Aki. I just want to do something for good ol' sis...
units.displayText: You wouldn't get it anyway, Aki. I just want to do something for good ol' sis...

spans.text: You wouldn't get it anyway, Aki. I just want to do something for good ol' sis...

units.rawText: Ol' sis? So it's for Daiyan?
units.displayText: Ol' sis? So it's for Daiyan?

spans.text: Ol' sis? So it's for Daiyan?

units.rawText: Ack... never mind, pretend I never said anything! I gotta go, we'll call it here for today!
units.displayText: Ack... never mind, pretend I never said anything! I gotta go, we'll call it here for today!

spans.text: Ack... never mind, pretend I never said anything! I gotta go, we'll call it here for today!

units.displayText: Aki watches as Jiangyu packs up her belongings, rubbing his chin.

units.rawText: ...You know what, I'll come with you.
units.displayText: ...You know what, I'll come with you.

spans.text: ...You know what, I'll come with you.

units.rawText: Eh? Changed your mind?
units.displayText: Eh? Changed your mind?

spans.text: Eh? Changed your mind?

units.rawText: Mm, I just thought that it'd be nice to fulfill my wish of having a year's supply of free gyutandon.
units.displayText: Mm, I just thought that it'd be nice to fulfill my wish of having a year's supply of free gyutandon.

spans.text: Mm, I just thought that it'd be nice to fulfill my wish of having a year's supply of free gyutandon.

units.rawText: So it all comes back to that, huh...
units.displayText: So it all comes back to that, huh...

spans.text: So it all comes back to that, huh...

units.rawText: Unadon will do as well. In any case, would it hurt for you to have a helping hand?

units.rawText: You're right. Thanks, Aki!
units.displayText: You're right. Thanks, Aki!
